get_model_from_zoo: get a pre-trained D2Go model by config path using model_zoo.get with trained=True
get_config_for_model: get a CfgNode config object for a D2Go model using model_zoo.get_config with a config path
get_checkpoint_url: get the download URL for a trained model checkpoint using model_zoo.get_checkpoint_url with a config path
get_config_file_path: get the filesystem path to a builtin D2Go config YAML file using model_zoo.get_config_file
list_available_models: list available pre-trained model config names from _ModelZooUrls.CONFIG_PATH_TO_URL_SUFFIX mapping
